title: First Opium War
summary: Britain went to war after China tried to stop the opium trade; China lost and ceded Hong Kong Island.
why: Later seen by Chinese nationalists as the start of a 'century of humiliation'.

notes.problem: Place too narrow: infobox location is 'China'; war ended with the Treaty of Nanking imposed at Nanjing (east-central China), not only the south.
Source: 'Twentieth-century nationalists considered 1839 the start of a century of humiliation'; treaty ceded Hong Kong Island.
